cas.name: Common Addresses
cas.description: Common addresses (ASDU addresses) of the stations behind this connection, a comma separated list of numbers and ranges, e.g. 1,2,5-8. The tag address is written as ca!ioa
cas.description_zh: 该连接下所有站点的公共地址（ASDU 地址），以逗号分隔，支持区间，如 1,2,5-8。点位地址格式为 公共地址!信息体地址

interval.name: Station Interrogation Interval
interval.description: The interval of sending station interrogation(s) to each station, unit second
interval.description_zh: 向每个站点发送总召唤的间隔，单位为秒

sync_time_interval.name: Sync Time Interval
sync_time_interval.description: The interval of sending sync time (C_CS_NA_1) to each station, 0 to disable
sync_time_interval.description_zh: 向每个站点发送时钟同步的间隔，单位为秒 (C_CS_NA_1)，0 表示关闭

remote_pulse_interval.name: Remote Pulse Interval
remote_pulse_interval.description: The interval of sending remote pulse (C_CI_NA_1) to each station, 0 to disable
remote_pulse_interval.description_zh: 向每个站点发送遥脉的间隔，单位为秒 (C_CI_NA_1)，0 表示关闭

station_timeout.name: Station Timeout
station_timeout.description: Report the tags of a station as error when it sends nothing for this long, unit second, 0 to disable
station_timeout.description_zh: 某站点在该时间内没有上送任何数据时，将其点位置为错误，单位为秒，0 表示关闭

t0.name: T0
t0.description: T0 timeout, the timeout of establishing TCP connection, unit second
t0.description_zh: T0 超时时间，建立 TCP 连接的超时时间，单位秒

t1.name: T1
t1.description: T1 timeout, the timeout of waiting for response, unit second
t1.description_zh: T1 超时时间，等待接收方响应请求的超时时间，单位秒

t2.name: T2
t2.description: If no I frame is received within T2 time, send S frame, unit second
t2.description_zh: 如果 T2 时间内未接收到新的 I 帧报文，则发送 S 帧报文，单位秒

t3.name: T3
t3.description: If no I frame is received within T3 time, send test frame, unit second
t3.description_zh: 如果 T3 时间内未接收到任何报文，则发送测试报文，单位秒

w.name: W
w.description: If W I frames are received, send S frame
w.description_zh: 如果接收到 W 个 I 帧，必定发送 S 帧

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: The interval of resending the start frame, unit second
timeout.description_zh: 重发启动帧的间隔，单位为秒

active.name: Active
active.description_zh: 设备主动上送数据时，是否开启及时推送

meta.name: META
meta.description: Enable upload meta data (quality and time)
meta.description_zh: 是否上传元数据（品质位和时标）
